newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Labour Party launches election Website.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Labour Party launches election Website.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party has launched an election campaign Website to inform Internet users about its policies in the run up to the national election on May 1.

The company that created the Website, "The Wire Station", said on Thursday the Labour Party decided to take its campaign to the Internet following the success of Websites created for last year's U.S. presidental election.

The new Website -- located at www.labourwin97.org.uk -- says "All roads lead to Labour". It invites Internet users to click with a mouse for information on "campaign drive", "party place", "policy street" or "school elections".

The Conservative Party urged British Internet users earlier this week to send Prime Minister John Major electronic mail -- or e-mail -- during the election campaign by visiting the party's new site at www.conservative-party.org.uk.
Britain's Conservatives have been in power since 1979.
